description:
As an engineering counsellor operating in Maharashtra, you play a pivotal role in guiding aspiring engineers through their educational and career paths. Your expertise lies in understanding the diverse engineering disciplines and the various institutions available in the state. You provide personalized advice to students, helping them identify their strengths, interests, and career goals.

Your responsibilities include conducting one-on-one counselling sessions, organizing workshops, and providing information on entrance exams, admission processes, and scholarship opportunities. You stay updated on industry trends and job market demands, ensuring that your guidance is relevant and beneficial.

Additionally, you foster relationships with educational institutions and industry professionals, creating a network that can support your clients in their academic and professional journeys. Your commitment to empowering students and helping them make informed decisions is at the heart of your counselling practice.
